task.title: `workbook rebuild` says when it left relics out
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M25). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

`workbook rebuild` prints "Rebuilt 2 task(s) and 2 relic(s)" and nothing else when two more relics could not be indexed (one written by a newer Workbook, one with a missing parent commit). The user is not told that relics were left out.

## Wanted

Report how many relics were not indexed and why, in text and in JSON.

## Done when

- A rebuild that skips a relic says so and names it.
- The JSON result carries the skipped relics in a documented member.
